title: Why Bold & Beautiful Fans Think Luna Is Still Obsessed With Will - NewsBreak
text: The ongoing storyline in The Bold and the Beautiful reveals that Luna is alive, and ever since she’s come out of danger, Will has been constantly on her mind. For those unfamiliar, Luna was shot and presumed dead, but in reality, she had been under Dr. Li’s care and is now ready to stir up some trouble. She seems to be fixated on Will, who is currently dating Electra. However, winning the man of her dreams won’t be easy, as numerous challenges await once everyone learns she is alive. Luna has been obsessed with Will since the day they met. Her obsession grew when she found out he had saved his girlfriend from a stalker named Remy. In the current storyline, too, it seems she cannot get him out of her mind and might try to get his love. Will, on the other hand, was involved in a sting operation and desperately wanted Luna behind bars. But that hasn’t stopped Luna from obsessing over him. Ever since she woke up from recovering from the gunshot, Will has been on her mind nonstop. But, she will have to face many troubles to win Will, who’s committed to Electra. Firstly, Luna will have to get rid of Will’s beau. She might even team up with Remy to cause trouble in the couple’s lives, but they have to make sure to keep it within legal bounds. However, the simplest way could be for Luna to find out about Katie’s party for Will at Il Giardino. She could sneak in pretending to be Electra and get to share some quality time with Will. While she could potentially apply these ways, there could still be more complicated troubles, given that she is a wanted woman who tried to kill Steffy. On the contrary, many also think that Luna might just drop her obsession with Will. However, he might still need to be alert, given that Luna might seek revenge on him and Electra. Previously, Lisa Yamada shared details on what’s going on in Luna’s mind regarding Will in an interview with Soaps.com . She said, “In her mind, a Will/Luna relationship is already written in the cards, Will just doesn’t know it yet. I think the biggest obstacle for Will is that Luna’s a murderess. He seems like he’s got a good head on his shoulders, so I imagine murder is where he draws the line. But she stops at nothing when she sees something she wants.” Shazmeen Navrange Shazmeen is an Entertainment journalist at Evolve Media, also covering Pop Culture beat. Her ardor for cinema led her into entertainment journalism. While her cinematic preferences know no bounds, she specifically has a fondness for the Marvel Cinematic Universe, psychological thrillers, horror, and films with profound philosophical undertones.
